# Chaparral Park Homes — Chaparral Park, Scottsdale 85250 Neighborhood Guide

> Chaparral Park Homes (chaparralparkhomes.com) is a neighborhood guide to Chaparral Park and the 85250 zip code in Scottsdale, AZ, by Elizabeth Vijan, a licensed Arizona real estate agent with the Tackett Team at eXp Realty (AZ License #SA708105000). It covers the park, the Indian Bend Wash greenbelt, Scottsdale Unified schools, Old Town and dining, and buying, selling and investing in 85250.

## About Chaparral Park
- Chaparral Park is a City of Scottsdale park at 5401 N. Hayden Road, Scottsdale, AZ 85250, with 100 acres of park space.
- Amenities: dog park (open 5:30am–10pm), fully inclusive playground, aquatic center, community center, and a lake with a fishing pier.
- Greenbelt: connects to the 12-mile Indian Bend Wash path through 85250.
- Schools: Scottsdale Unified School District (SUSD).
- About 10 minutes to Old Town Scottsdale.
